overview_description.description: Weave develops an AI-powered patient communications, engagement, and payments platform for small and medium-sized healthcare practices. The platform integrates voice, text, email, online scheduling, appointment reminders, digital forms, review management, analytics, and payment processing into a unified system. Its AI capabilities include an AI receptionist, automated text conversations, call intelligence, response assistance, and workflow automation to help practices manage patient interactions and administrative tasks. Weave also provides payment tools such as Text to Pay, online bill pay, payment plans, card-on-file payments, and payment terminals. The company serves healthcare practices across specialties, including dental, medical, veterinary, and other outpatient care providers.

about_short_description.short_description: Weave develops an AI-powered patient communications, engagement, and payments platform for small and medium-sized healthcare practices.

product.name: Weave Platform
product.description: A cloud-based patient communications and practice management platform combining phone, messaging, scheduling, payments, reviews, analytics, and automation for healthcare practices.

product.name: Weave Phones
product.description: A cloud-based VoIP phone system for healthcare practices with call routing, call management, voicemail transcription, patient information access, and mobile or desktop use.

product.name: Weave Texting
product.description: A two-way patient messaging service for appointment coordination, reminders, missed-call follow-up, billing communications, operational updates, and customer service.

product.name: Weave Payments
product.description: A healthcare payment solution supporting in-office card transactions, online bill payment, Text to Pay, card-on-file billing, mobile wallets, payment plans, and financing options.

product.name: Weave AI Tools
product.description: A set of AI-powered tools for automating patient conversations, analyzing calls, drafting communications, transcribing voicemails, and confirming appointments.

product.name: TrueLark
product.description: An AI patient engagement service that communicates through text, chat, and voice to answer questions, follow up with leads, and schedule appointments when staff are unavailable.
